instructions: Inspect and modify workspace files with list, read, write and edit. Examples: {"action":"list","path":"."}, {"action":"read","path":"notes.txt"}, {"action":"write","path":"notes.txt","content":"new text"}. Read is paginated: follow next_offset when truncated. read limit is at most 16384 bytes and list limit at most 200 entries; larger requests are clamped to the maximum. The easiest edit is find/replace: {"action":"edit","path":"f.py","find":"<exact current text>","replace":"<new text>"} replaces one unique occurrence - no offsets or hashes; if find matches several places, include more surrounding lines. The byte form (start/end/content/expected_sha256 from a fresh read) remains for precise ranges. Only enabled actions are available; writes and edits require the host approval policy. Paths are workspace-relative and confined to the workspace; an absolute path inside the workspace is accepted. list accepts cursor and limit; follow next_cursor. read offset/limit and edit start/end count bytes; edits require UTF-8 character boundaries. content_base64 is authoritative when present. write atomically replaces the whole file; edit atomically replaces [start,end) only if expected_sha256 still matches. Create long files in pieces: write the first part, then add each next part with {"action":"write","path":...,"content":...,"append":true} - a single very long write risks a truncated reply.
